name: Kiran Shankar Roy
contribution: Roy was the Bengal Congress Parliamentary Party leader who joined the 1947 effort to consider an undivided, independent Bengal.
context: During the final constitutional negotiations before British withdrawal, Roy’s position sat between Congress’s all-India strategy and Bengal-specific proposals for a sovereign united Bengal.
impact: His role records the range of constitutional options debated in Bengal before partition became the settled outcome.
seoDescription: Profile of Kiran Shankar Roy, tracing connections to the 1947 Partition, Eastern Bengal, and related political-cultural history.
shortAnswer: Kiran Shankar Roy is linked to the 1947 Partition in this timeline as Congress Leader in Bengal.

faq.question: How is Kiran Shankar Roy connected to the 1947 Partition?
faq.answer: Kiran Shankar Roy is connected to the partition era as Congress Leader in Bengal. He was part of the late negotiations over Bengal's constitutional future and was associated with the United Bengal discussions.
